title: Counters write to Apple Watch active minutes!!
body: Turning on a counter on the Apple Watch for any habit (like reading x minutes) writes Active minutes to Apple Watch activities (the green ring). One hour of reading in HabitMinder gave me 60 active minutes. This bug needs to be fixed fast. Until then 1 star rating as the counters are unusable this way.
